82.text: Module Federation loads remote modules into the shell's own JavaScript realm — same document, no shadow root. All components share the same realm, so portals resolve into the shell's document by default. EnvironmentProvider is not needed.

192.text: Tonic UI v3 introduces a new token system based on dot notation and semantic tokens that automatically adapt to light and dark modes. Key benefits: Automatic color mode handling — no need for manual colorMode switching Semantic meaning — tokens express intent, not raw color values Improved consistency — better alignmen
